palette: Silver-gray wood, desaturated blue grain, and soft teal-white inner traces.
valueRange: Cool middle-light values with translucent-looking edges.
surfaceAndWear: Smooth ancient grain, soft ghostlike striations, few physical scars, clean grown joints.
constructionVocabulary: Elegant sweeping limbs, forked growth, hollow negative spaces, floating-looking but connected rings.
supernaturalBehavior: A restrained inner glow follows selected grain lines; the object remains solid wood.
neutralSecondaryMaterials: Silver, gray leather, pale cord, and charcoal cloth.
neighborDifference: Cooler, lighter, and more spectral than Heartwood; less lush and actively growing than Living Branch.
